svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 6: three per capstan, all the same.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tube: SHS 40 x 40 x 3 mm, 388 mm long, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End plates: 100 x 80 x 6 mm, two per tube, welded on centre so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the length over both plates is 400 mm (the gap between cheeks).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 11 mm holes in each plate, 36 mm each side of the tube centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the long centre line, so the washers clear the welds.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld all round, 5 mm fillet; keep the outer faces flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Galvanise; run a drill through the holes after galvanising.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: plates sit flat on the inner faces of the cheeks, two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M10 bolts each end. Positions: front low (240 ahead, 110 up),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear low (240 behind, 110 up) and top (over the drum, 850 up).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 400 mm over the plates, within 1 mm, plates parallel.
